cards.text: Paul's in Ephesus, where a silversmith named Demetrius just got the whole city worked up over the goddess Artemis, and the city filled with confusion (Acts 19:24-29). Now the uproar is finally over, and Paul's about to head out. But before he goes, he sends for the disciples.

cards.question: Before Paul leaves Ephesus, he sends for the disciples and ___ them.

cards.text: He says goodbye and leaves for Macedonia, speaking many words of encouragement all through that area. Then he arrives in Greece, where he stays three months.
Paul's about to sail for Syria when the Jews form a plot against him. Friend, my heart jumps when the oven timer BEEPS, and this man's got a whole PLOT to deal with.

cards.question: With a plot against him just as he's about to sail for Syria, Paul decides to go back through ___.

cards.text: Seven men travel with Paul, and one of them is Timothy, a disciple Paul took along on his travels (Acts 16:1-3). They go on ahead and wait in Troas, and catch this: the writer says they waited for "us," so whoever's writing this story is on the trip too.

cards.question: Paul and the writer sail from Philippi to catch up with the others in Troas. After which feast do they set sail?

cards.text: Five days later they rejoin the others in Troas, and they stay there seven days. On the first day of the week, they all come together to break bread, and Paul talks to them.

cards.question: In Troas, Paul keeps on talking to the gathering until midnight. Why does he keep going so long?

answers.text: He's ready to leave the next day
The crowd keeps asking him questions
He's waiting for the others to arrive

cards.text: There are many lamps in the upper room, and a young man named Eutychus is sitting in the window. Paul talks on and on, and friend, I have seen ovens preheat FASTER than this talk wraps up.

cards.question: As Paul talks on and on, Eutychus sinks into a deep sleep.

cards.text: Eutychus is sound asleep. Then he falls from the third story.

cards.question: When they pick Eutychus up after his fall from the third story, he's shaken up but fine.

cards.text: Eutychus is picked up dead. But Paul goes down, throws himself on the young man and embraces him.

cards.question: Holding Eutychus, Paul tells everyone, "Do not be alarmed!" What else does he tell them?

answers.text: The young man is still alive

cards.question: After a night like THAT, I'd need a week off. Paul goes back upstairs, breaks bread and eats. Then what does he do?
At daybreak Paul departs, and the people are greatly ___ to take the boy home alive.

cards.text: Paul's heading back out on the road, friend, and trust me, this journey isn't done yet.
